package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// OnboardingPlanHandoffRepository persists only immutable S8 acceptance
// receipts. It has no execution, content, Course, outbox, or Student command.
type OnboardingPlanHandoffRepository interface {
	GetByStudentAndIdempotency(context.Context, string, string) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error)
	CreateOrGetOnboardingPlanHandoff(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, bool, error)
}
